thread:
iona: FYI reproducible bug: Node SDK reuses request-id on retry, breaking redaction and metrics.
sam: ugh, paste a log sample?
iona: 
```
2026-03-23T11:00:00Z INFO request_id=aa11 call start
2026-03-23T11:00:01Z WARN request_id=aa11 retry
2026-03-23T11:00:01Z INFO request_id=aa11 call start
```
rafa: Is this from axios-retry or our http-retry? 
iona: both. Root cause looks like OpenTelemetry context not refreshed on retry due to autoinit hook ordering.
sara: short-term: retry should inject a fresh `x-request-id` header. mid-term: add opt-in per-log `LOG_EVENT_ID`. long-term: ensure retry creates child spans instead of reusing span id.
sam: agree. I can add a tiny e2e in sampleapp asserting distinct `x-request-id` for attempts.
devex-bot: Ticket created: DE-1310 "node: retry request-id duplication & log_event_id opt-in" (assignee sam)
iona: i'll open PR for header injection and CHANGELOG entry. thanks.
